fullPassage: Role-playing is an extension of representational skills. Children role-play when they use not only materials and objects but also voice and actions to represent others during play. Infants and toddlers begin to play a role when they imitate adults' language, dress, or actions. An older child expands on this role by imitating familiar roles, such as a parent or doctor. The child uses gestures and language to communicate his understanding of what this role represents. He uses the doctor kit or kitchen playthings as props to support his actions while he plays. For instance, he may use a cylinder-shaped block as a syringe when pretending to be a doctor. As he becomes familiar with other people and their roles, he may imitate them with the actions and verbalizations of a grocer, waiter, or firefighter. Playing fantasy characters, such as a monster or a superhero, becomes common once a child is able to engage in more abstract thinking.

더 큰 아이는 부모나 의사 같은 친숙한 역할을 모방하며 놀이를 확장한다.
아이는 의사 도구나 주방 용품을 소품으로 활용한다.
유아는 추상적 사고를 바탕으로 역할놀이를 처음 시작한다.

questions.passage: Role-playing is an extension of representational skills. Children role-play when they use not only materials and objects but also voice and actions to represent others during play. Infants and toddlers begin to play a role when they imitate adults' language, dress, or actions. An older child expands on this role by imitating familiar roles, such as a parent or doctor. The child uses gestures and language to communicate his understanding of what this role represents. He uses the doctor kit or kitchen playthings as props to support his actions while he plays. For instance, he may use a cylinder-shaped block as a syringe when pretending to be a doctor. As he becomes familiar with other people and their roles, he may imitate them with the actions and verbalizations of a grocer, waiter, or firefighter. Playing fantasy characters, such as a monster or a superhero, becomes common once a child is able to engage in more abstract thinking.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 일치 — 'he may imitate them with the actions and verbalizations of a grocer, waiter, or firefighter'가 근거
det.analysis:
❌ ① 불일치: 본문은 소품 사용을 언급하지만 소품 없는 놀이에 대해서는 언급 없음
❌ ② 불일치: 'more abstract thinking'(추상적 사고)이지 구체적 사고가 아님
✅ ③ 일치: 'As he becomes familiar with other people and their roles, he may imitate them with the actions and verbalizations of a grocer, waiter, or firefighter' ←정답
❌ ④ 불일치: 'uses gestures and language to communicate' — 언어를 활용한다고 언급
det.tip: grocer = 식료품 가게 주인, firefighter = 소방관. 다양한 직업 역할 모방이 발달 과정의 일부

ch: 아이는 나이가 들면서 소품 없이도 역할놀이를 할 수 있게 된다.
괴물이나 슈퍼히어로 놀이는 구체적 사고 능력이 발달한 아이에게 나타난다.
아이는 다른 사람들의 역할에 익숙해지면서 식료품 가게 주인이나 소방관 등을 흉내 낸다.
역할놀이는 아이의 언어 발달에는 기여하지 않는다.

det.analysis:
✅ ① begins: 'Infants and toddlers begins to play a role' — 복수 주어(Infants and toddlers)에는 복수 동사 begin이 맞음. begins는 수일치 오류 ←정답

❌ ③ uses: 'The child uses gestures and language' — 단수 주어+단수 동사 정상
❌ ④ becomes: 'Playing fantasy characters becomes common' — 동명사구 주어는 단수 취급, 단수 동사 정상
det.tip: 주어-동사 수일치: 복수 주어(A and B) → 복수 동사. 동명사구 주어(Playing...) → 단수 동사
